Anduril Industries | mid/Sr/Staff Full Stack Software Engineers, ArsenalOS Team | Costa Mesa, CA ideally, (would consider remote with travel) | JavaScript/TypeScript, React, Node/Next.js, PostgreSQL

Anduril's ArsenalOS handles all receipt, manufacturing, deployment and maintenance of all Anduril hardware that is shipped to our customers. We are looking for a Full Stack Senior Software Engineer to join the ArsenalOS team. As a Full Stack Senior Software Engineer on ArsenalOS you will be architecting and implementing mission-critical solutions that enforce lean business process, add multiplicative leverage to Anduril employees, and scale Anduril into a next-generation defense prime.

WHAT YOU’LL DO: -Own and deliver features for Forge, Anduril’s production platform. -Level up our team’s applications through quality code contribution and writing tests. -Leverage frontier AI tooling for development, and contribute to our local Forge harness. -Partner with the factory floor to enable high rate build of Roadrunner, Fury, and other Anduril products. -Join an on-call rotation for Forge support of the production floor. -Collaborate cross-functionally with systems architecture, software product and design, factory systems, and production digital tools.

Please apply here: https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/andurilindustries/jobs/5036... .
